note: The archival deposit of this version, in a repository Council of AI does not control. Recorded here rather than inside the specification document itself, so that the bytes deposited and the bytes served stay identical and the published digest keeps checking out against both. Both deposits are versions of one concept DOI; the concept DOI always resolves to the current one.
does_not_prove: that the specification is endorsed by Zenodo, CERN or anyone else — a repository deposit is storage and an identifier, not a review
that the specification is correct; a DOI makes a document citable and permanent, not right

supersedes.reason: The first deposit phrased one bullet of the specification's 4.6 using a term of art that the publisher's own public-surface gate forbids on any page it ships. The wording was replaced with a plain-English equivalent of identical meaning before the specification was ever served from its canonical URL. No normative requirement changed. The first record stays citable and immutable: a published version is superseded, never edited.
